observations: A single motorcycle tyre is shown in a close-up.
The tread pattern consists of a central diamond shape with multiple smaller diamond patterns.
The sidewall is visible but lacks clear branding or markings.
A watermark 'CENTOCAUTOS' is present on the image.
The tyre appears to be in good cosmetic condition.

risks.risk: The tyre may be a generic or low-quality brand rather than a specific manufacturer's model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the sidewall showing the brand name and model number.

risks.risk: The tyre may be expired or have a hidden age stamp.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the date code stamped on the sidewall.

risks.risk: The tyre may be a different size from the one the buyer intends to purchase.
risks.proof: A photo of the tyre's size markings (e.g., 120/70R15) on the sidewall.

proof_requests: Photo of the sidewall showing the brand and model.
Photo of the date code on the sidewall.
Photo of the tyre size markings (e.g., 120/70R15).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
